item.title: Business Analyst II
item.description:
Role Overview:

The Business Analyst will report to, and work closely with, our central operations team lead. In this role you will need to identify and implement data-driven scalable strategies to grow our business. Successful team members have an “extreme ownership” mentality, understand the importance of data and attention to detail, and are high-energy solution oriented problem solvers. We’re looking for team players who are looking to make an immediate impact at a high-growth disruptive startup. This role can be remote (U.S. based only), or in-person in McLean, Virginia.

Opportunities:

  • Develop and use analytical tools to measure and generate ways to improve customer acquisition/retention/engagement and grow overall platform usage

  • Hands-on assistance managing dynamic and growing marketplaces using custom dashboards

  • Serve in both project management and operator roles on various short-term and long-term ops, comms, and marketing initiatives

  • Help manage and improve our automated drip campaigns. This includes ensuring timely and consistent deployment, as well as conducting in-depth analyses of open rates and campaign effectiveness

  • Draft copy for and implement email, text, and other digital communication and marketing campaigns

  • Run and expand Empower’s vehicle-exterior advertising program

  • Run and expand Empower’s in-vehicle marketing efforts

  • Help create content for Empower’s unpaid, organic social media campaigns

  • Help manage paid media campaigns to maximize RO

Candidate Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or other 4-year degree with high academic achievement

  • 3-5 years of post college professional experience, ideally in a fast paced environment

  • Experience in data analytics (proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets required; experience with SQL/R/Python is a plus).

  • An innate understanding of ROI

  • Ambitious and dependable

What Do We Offer?

  • Competitive compensation: $80,000 - $100,000 base salary (based on experience) + equity + performance based bonus + competitive benefits

  • Being part of a great team to better the lives of gig workers

  • Exposure to C-Suite and other senior team members across all departments

  • No dull or unchallenging days!

We are currently unable to sponsor visas for this position

item.title: Senior Developer Advocate
item.description:
About Unleash

Unleash is a feature management platform helping development teams experiment faster with new features, with less risk and more efficiency. Our mantra is "create with freedom, release with confidence".

Feature management has emerged as a core component of Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and Experimentation Platforms, allowing developers to test new features incrementally, roll back with precision, and run experiments that drive real product decisions. Unleash is the largest open source solution for feature management on GitHub, and serves some of the world's most security-conscious enterprises. From financial institutions and fintechs to large retailers and government bodies.

Unleash has solid funding from investors across the US, UK, and Norway, and is growing.
We're a remote-first company across 10 countries, with a Nordic culture based on trust, transparency, and autonomy.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Developer Advocate to join our small but growing DevRel team. You'll work closely with the Head of DevRel and own a significant portion of our technical content strategy and community execution, from blog posts and tutorials to live demos, workshops, and conference talks.

This is a high-autonomy role. You won't be handed a backlog to execute. You'll help shape what gets built and why, co-owning parts of the DevRel strategy. We're a small team and we move fast, so the ability to self-direct, prioritize ruthlessly, and deliver with speed and precision matters a lot.
Our primary audience is the technical practitioner: developers, DevOps engineers, platform engineers, and software architects working in and around enterprise software. You'll need to be able to speak their language with credibility. That means being hands-on, technically sharp, and genuinely curious about the problems they face.

Responsibilities

  • Own and execute technical content across formats: written tutorials, blog posts, code examples, video walkthroughs, and live demos

  • Speak at developer conferences, meetups, and community events

  • Design and run developer workshops (in-person and virtual)

  • Contribute to the Unleash OSS ecosystem: code samples, integrations, documentation improvements, and SDK examples

  • Engage with the developer community across channels and represent Unleash with authenticity

  • Collaborate with Customer Success and Go-to-Market teams to identify technical content gaps and opportunities

  • Stay sharp on the AI/LLM tooling landscape and help translate Unleash's value into that context for developers building AI-powered applications


About you

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on experience, spanning real software engineering and Developer Relations (you've done both, not just talked about both)

  • You've shipped production code and can build working demos, integrations, and code samples from scratch

  • You have genuine experience in Developer Relations: you've spoken at conferences, produced technical content, and know what it takes to build credibility in a developer community

  • You're comfortable with CI/CD, cloud-native technologies, and modern DevOps/platform engineering practices

  • You have hands-on experience building with AI/LLM tools and can speak fluently about integrating AI into real applications

  • You can speak credibly to a technical enterprise audience of developers, architects, and platform teams in large organizations, without losing the startup instinct for speed and pragmatism

  • You thrive with autonomy. You don't need a lot of hand-holding, and you default to action over process

  • A growing LinkedIn or YouTube presence is a strong plus. We're not looking for influencer-scale followings, but an established voice in the developer community signals the right mindset

  • Familiarity with OpenFeature or the feature management space is a bonus, not a requirement

Skills & Experience

  • Experience level: Senior Individual Contributor, 10+ years across software engineering and Developer Relations

  • Core skills: Technical content creation, public speaking, live demos, developer education

  • Technical skills:Node.js, TypeScript, CI/CD pipelines, cloud-native technologies (e.g. Kubernetes, OpenFeature), AI/LLM tooling and integrations

  • Additional skills: OSS contribution, SDK/integration development, video production, community building

Logistics

  • Base salary: $230-250K + Equity

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Reports to: Head of DevRel

  • Location: NYC preferred, other major East Coast cities considered

  • Remote working: Fully remote

  • Working timezones: EST, with some overlapping with CET

  • Visa sponsorship: Not available

    Company Benefits

    Competitive salary, Stock options, Benefits Package, Annual company offsite, Flexible schedule, Fully remote.

Unleash is the controller of your personal data for the purposes of this recruitment. Amby AS acts as the processor of your personal data, except when you agree to join our Talent Pool, in which case Amby also becomes the data controller. We process your personal data to manage and conduct the recruitment process. You have the right to access your data, request rectification, erasure, and restriction of processing, as well as the right to object to processing and data transfer. For a more detailed understanding of how we handle your data, the purposes of processing, and your rights, please refer to Amby's Privacy Policy and Unleash Privacy Policy
